name: simple-coding-time-tracker
description: Coding time tracking + AI usage insights for VS Code — Track coding time per project, branch & language, see Claude Code token/cost usage, with smart activity detection, health reminders, and beautiful visualizations

simpleCodingInsights.inactivityTimeout.description: Pause tracking if there is no keyboard or mouse activity in VS Code for this many minutes.

simpleCodingInsights.focusTimeout.description: If you switch away from VS Code, continue counting as coding time for up to this many minutes before pausing.

simpleCodingInsights.statusBar.showSecon.description: Show seconds in the status bar time display (disable to reduce distractions)

simpleCodingInsights.statusBar.icon.description: Icon or Codicon name to display before the timer (e.g., '$(code)', '$(clock)', '$(rocket)', or any emoji)

simpleCodingInsights.statusBar.backgroun.description: Background style for the timer in the status bar: default (theme), warning (yellow), or error (red).

simpleCodingInsights.statusBar.color.description: Custom color for the timer text in hex format (e.g., '#FFAA00') or a VS Code theme color reference

simpleCodingInsights.health.enableNotifi.description: Enable health notifications during coding sessions

simpleCodingInsights.health.modalNotific.description: Make health notifications modal (blocks UI until dismissed) for better visibility

simpleCodingInsights.health.eyeRestInter.description: Interval for eye rest reminders (minutes) - Based on 20-20-20 rule

simpleCodingInsights.health.stretchInter.description: Interval for stretch reminders (minutes) - Recommended for posture health

simpleCodingInsights.health.breakThresho.description: Coding duration before suggesting a break (minutes) - Based on ultradian rhythms

simpleCodingInsights.claude.dataPath.description: Path to your Claude Code data directory for the Claude Code usage tab. Leave empty to use CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, or the default ~/.claude.

simpleCodingInsights.claude.showTab.description: Show the Claude Code usage tab in the dashboard.

simpleCodingInsights.claude.showNewFeatu.description: Show the "New feature" announcement banner for the Claude Code usage tab on the Coding Time dashboard.

simpleCodingInsights.claude.idleGapMinut.description: Gaps between Claude Code messages longer than this (minutes) are treated as time away, not active session time.

simpleCodingInsights.enableDevCommands.description: Enable development commands (Generate/Delete Test Data). Only enable this for testing purposes.

commands.title: SCI: Clear All Time Tracking Data
SCI: Clear All Time Tracking Data

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.refresh-extension: code --uninstall-extension noorashuvo.simple-coding-time-tracker && vsce package && code --install-extension $(npm pack --quiet)
